title: FlexUMM: Flexible Representation Learning for Unified Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can integrate understanding and generation within a single backbone. However, it is commonly known that these two capabilities can cause conflicting representations, leading to a central question: how representation and computation should be shared across functionalities? Existing UMMs often rely on a largely fixed structure, where different inputs and functionalities follow the same depth and parameter-sharing pattern. We argue that this assumption is too restrictive: more effective unification requires sharing the computation that supports cross-functional communication while specializing the capacity that becomes task- or input-specific. We introduce FlexUMM, a flexible UMM framework that dynamically decides when to preserve shared computation, when to route specialized capacity, and when to stop further processing. Evidence shows that this flexible allocation improves UMMs along two complementary axes

translated_title: FlexUMM：面向统一多模态模型的灵活表示学习
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）能够在单一骨干网络中整合理解与生成能力。然而，众所周知，这两种能力可能导致表示上的冲突，由此引出一个核心问题：表示与计算应当如何在不同功能之间进行共享？现有的统一多模态模型通常依赖于基本固定的结构，即不同的输入和功能遵循相同的深度和参数共享模式。我们认为这一假设过于严苛：更有效的统一需要共享支持跨功能通信的计算，同时对任务或输入特定的容量进行专门化。我们提出了FlexUMM，一个灵活的统一多模态模型框架，它能够动态决定何时保留共享计算、何时路由专门化容量以及何时停止进一步处理。证据表明，这种灵活的分配在两个互补的维度上提升了统一多模态模型的性能。
tldr: FlexUMM提出了一种灵活的统一多模态模型框架，通过动态决定何时共享计算、何时路由专门化容量以及何时停止处理，有效解决了理解与生成两种能力之间的表示冲突问题。
en_tdlr: FlexUMM is a flexible unified multimodal model framework that dynamically decides when to preserve shared computation, when to route specialized capacity, and when to stop further processing, effectively resolving the representation conflict between understanding and generation capabilities.
